manifest.title: Ambient ground motion measured near Giza

params.method: McNamara & Buland (2004) via obspy PPSD, 1 h windows, 50% overlap

finding: At Kottamya, 67 km east of Giza, the median vertical ground velocity is 0.049 um/s in the microseism band (0.1-0.3 Hz) and 0.029 um/s by day, 0.028 um/s by night at 1-3 Hz (1996, twelve days, instrument response removed). Peterson's global models bound the microseism band between 0.02 and 3.5 um/s.
